dishes.name: Cherry-leaf rolls
dishes.desc: Young cherry leaves wrapped around a filling of bulgur or split peas and meat, then simmered. A signature of the Malatya orchard country and available in local restaurants in season.

dishes.name: Kağıt kebabı
dishes.desc: Lamb and vegetables cooked wrapped in paper in a stone oven so the juices stay in. A Malatya way of cooking that is easy to find in the city.

dishes.name: Apricot dessert with kaymak
dishes.desc: Whole Malatya apricots cooked in syrup and served with thick clotted cream and nuts. The province grows a large share of the world's dried apricots.

dishes.name: Gırık
dishes.desc: Meatballs of bulgur and minced meat served in a light, sour broth. A Malatya home-style dish from the region's long bulgur tradition.

dishes.name: Malatya pestil and kesmece
dishes.desc: Sheets of dried plum, mulberry or apricot fruit leather, often cut and eaten with walnuts. A traditional Malatya sweet sold in bazaar shops.
